name: ALwrity AI-first Digital Marketing Platform
description: An AI-driven digital marketing platform providing content strategy and planning, multimodal content generation, publishing, analytics, SEO optimization, and social account management to streamline marketing operations.

inputs.name: marketing_goals
inputs.description: High-level marketing objectives or campaign goals.

inputs.name: content_brief
inputs.description: Detailed description of content requirements or topics.

inputs.name: existing_content_data
inputs.description: Current marketing content in various formats for analysis and enhancement.

inputs.name: social_media_accounts
inputs.description: User's connected social media accounts for management and publishing.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: Keywords targeted for AI-powered SEO optimization.

inputs.name: performance_metrics
inputs.description: Campaign or published content metrics for AI analytics and insights.

outputs.name: content_strategy_plan
outputs.description: AI-generated strategic plan for digital marketing content.

outputs.name: multimodal_content
outputs.description: Generated content in various formats such as text, images, and videos for marketing use.

outputs.name: published_content_report
outputs.description: Summary and status of published content across platforms.

outputs.name: analytics_dashboard
outputs.description: Data-driven insights and metrics visualizations to track marketing effectiveness.

outputs.name: seo_recommendations
outputs.description: Suggested optimizations based on AI SEO analysis.

outputs.name: social_account_management_status
outputs.description: Information about connected social accounts, publishing schedules, and engagement.

patterns: Social media account integration and management
steps: Define marketing objectives and input content requirements.
Leverage AI to generate a content strategy and planning document.
Produce multimodal marketing content tailored to the strategy.
Connect and synchronize social media accounts for content publishing.
Publish content via integrated channels with scheduling capabilities.
Collect and analyze performance data with the analytics module.
Generate SEO recommendations using AI insights to improve content reach.
Iterate on strategy and content based on analytics and market response.
use_cases: Developing an AI-based content marketing plan for new product launches.
Automating creation and publishing of diverse marketing materials.
Optimizing existing content for better search engine rankings using AI insights.
Managing multiple social media accounts and scheduling posts from one platform.
Tracking campaign performance and making data-driven marketing decisions.

prompt_templates.name: content_strategy_generation
prompt_templates.template: Create a digital marketing content strategy targeting {marketing_goals} with focus on {content_brief}.

prompt_templates.name: multimodal_content_creation
prompt_templates.template: Generate {content_type} content based on the strategy: {content_strategy_plan}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the content for SEO opportunities focusing on these keywords: {seo_keywords}.

prompt_templates.name: analytics_insight_request
prompt_templates.template: Provide performance insights and recommendations for the campaign data: {performance_metrics}.

prompt_templates.name: social_media_publish_schedule
prompt_templates.template: Schedule publishing of content titled '{content_title}' across connected social media accounts on {publish_date}.
